name: Jericho Atrium
summary: Jericho Atrium is a community shopping center managed by Kimco Realty, strategically located on North Broadway in affluent Jericho, New York. The center serves as a convenient retail destination for Nassau County residents with consistent hours and a strong reputation in the local market.
demographics: Jericho Atrium serves the affluent Long Island community of Jericho and surrounding Nassau County areas, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes significantly above the national average. The trade area draws educated shoppers aged 35-65, many with children, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. Visitors typically exhibit strong purchasing power and preference for established retailers, with shopping patterns focused on weekly errands, dining, and service-oriented visits rather than destination shopping trips.
description: Jericho Atrium is a well-established shopping center located at 500 North Broadway in the heart of Jericho, New York, one of Long Island's most desirable communities. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, this property serves as a convenient retail hub for the surrounding Nassau County area. The center benefits from its prime location in Jericho, a community known for its excellent schools, affluent residents, and strong commercial activity along the Broadway corridor. With a solid 4.2-star rating from over 100 reviews, Jericho Atrium has established itself as a reliable destination for local shoppers seeking everyday conveniences and services. The center maintains consistent operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing accessibility for both weekday and weekend visitors throughout the year.
